tsa.title: International Nurses Day offer: a week of unlimited LED
rows: Offer
Seven days of unlimited LED sessions for nurses, starting from their first session.
Who
Nurses with current AHPRA registration. They show their registration, or a work ID, at the first visit.
Not for
Current members, who already have unlimited LED. Thank them in a story instead.
When
Launch Wed 12 May 2027. First session to be booked by Sun 23 May, and the week finishes by Sun 30 May.
Cap
Limited to 20 nurses, so the LED room stays bookable for members. Say so in the post.
Suitability
LED is chosen after a consultation. Anyone it doesn't suit gets a skin consultation instead.
Follow-up
On day 7, invite each nurse to join the membership at the current rate. This is where the money is.
Wording
"A week of LED, on us." Never "free" in the call to action. Example CTA: "Are you a nurse? Would you like a week of LED with us? Book through the link in our bio."
Story angle
A clinic co-founded by a nurse, saying thank you to nurses. No outcome claims about LED.
Compliance
Show the terms in the caption: who's eligible, the dates, the cap and one per person. AHPRA advertising rules expect clear terms on any gift or discount.

cp.title: International Nurses Day offer: 3 classes for nurses
rows: Offer
3 complimentary classes for nurses ($120 value at $40 a class).
Who
Nurses new to Club Pilates Sippy Downs. They show their AHPRA registration, or a work ID, at their first class.
When
Claim from Wed 12 May to Wed 26 May 2027, and use within 21 days.
Classes
They start in Level 1, as everyone does. Any class on the schedule within that level.
Limit
One per person. It can't be combined with the free intro class: this replaces it.
Set-up
Needs a $0 "Nurses Day 3 class" offer in ClubReady, with its own booking link (an Australian link). That's the only build task.
Follow-up
After class 3, offer the intro membership deal. Send a text on day 2 after the last class.
Wording
"3 classes on us for nurses." Using "free" is fine for Club Pilates.
Timing
Mother's Day is Sun 9 May. Launch the nurses post on Wed 12 May, not that weekend.
